Root-of-unity Fourier extraction isolates each coordinate resolvent; uniform superpolynomial seed growth eliminates monomial losses and proves the exact pointwise maximal local exponent. The compact decreasing-weight seed has an explicit resolvent lower-bound certificate for the growth hypothesis and published full power set; the interleaved shift has exact Calkin nilpotency index m from its finite compact power and surviving identity blocks at all smaller powers. Nilpotent zero seed demonstrates necessity of a growth-type restriction. Finite checker gives 1148 successful algebra/Fourier assertions, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A structural, pointwise resolvent-growth transfer theorem yields an exact invariant filtration and a boundary example. For every prescribed m>=2, it gives an explicit natural noncompact weighted shift with maximal power set [0,1] and exact nilpotency height m modulo compacts, separating two meaningful operator invariants. Unit weights escape the assumptions of prior compact decreasing-weight classifications; neither mere correctness nor a finite numerical curiosity is offered as the value justification.
